race.comment: Historic day with the Cox Plate at Flemington. Four of the first five races are down the straight and ICE KOOL (4) goes on top over the 1000m in the opener. He's a progressive gelding who has won 5/8, back to this trip at Warwick Farm last time and proving too strong for a handy one. 53.5kg and Damian Lane looks like a recipe for success. SPYWIRE (1) will find this easier than the G2 Schillaci Stakes at Caulfield last start when battling home behind Jigsaw. 1000m suits and he's the class of this field, hence the weight. BRED 'EM ALL (11) comes over from Adelaide off a smart return win. This is a big jump, but he's got ability. WAY TO THE STARS (2) comes back in grade from some tough runs in the A-grade in Sydney. He has won here. POINT AND SHOOT (3) likely finds them too sharp but can be running on.

Live1.SchedulerNote: *'Ladbrokes Cox Plate Day' P1 [Metro] Prize Money: $200,000
